description: This header file declares exported API functions for the Slap Bmc2 Application Object in the Service Logic Aggregation Plane (SLAP). It includes prototype definitions for creating, retrieving, and managing the application object, useful for inter-module interactions within the system.

methods.name: SlapCreateBmc2Application
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the Bmc2 Application object using given context handles.

methods.name: SlapBmc2AppoGetSlapObjCallMap
methods.description: Retrieves the SLAP object call map associated with the Bmc2 Application object.

methods.name: SlapBmc2AppoGetSlapObjDescriptor
methods.description: Obtains the SLAP object descriptor for the Bmc2 Application object.

methods.name: SlapBmc2AppoCreate
methods.description: Creates a new Bmc2 Application object instance.

methods.name: SlapBmc2AppoRemove
methods.description: Removes the Bmc2 Application object instance, performing cleanup.

methods.name: SlapBmc2AppoEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls necessary objects as part of application initialization.
